entries.question: Q1
entries.audit: Per-image Precision/Recall/F1 replay correctly to the reported rounded values. This arithmetic check does not validate the ground-truth masks; truth-label provenance is not stated.

entries.question: Q1
entries.audit: Strong pixel metrics require a reference-mask contract: annotator/source, ambiguity handling, independence from feature-weight/threshold tuning, and original-image holdout identity.

entries.question: Q2
entries.audit: The pseudocode does not specify how P is estimated or initialized, so the claimed four-parameter RANSAC chain is incomplete at the algorithm-contract level.

entries.question: Q2
entries.audit: The named horizontal criterion and the y-coordinate formula do not agree. Axis semantics must be explicit before transfer.

entries.question: Q2
entries.audit: No test family, test statistic, sample size, sample unit or pairing rule is reported in the paper text; the p-values cannot be independently interpreted/replayed from the visible evidence.

entries.question: Q2

reported.model2: fixes period P to reduce Hough dimension
reported.later_Q3: period P fixed to borehole circumference L

entries.audit: The paper itself recognizes the physical fixed-period contract in Q3. Q2 should justify why free P is needed, or prefer fixed P=pi*D/calibrated horizontal span.

entries.question: Q3
entries.audit: Resample estimator must match the fitted model unless a distinct likelihood is explicitly defined.

entries.question: Q3

reported.text: first is upper quantile, second is lower quantile

entries.audit: Conventional percentile CI is ordered [theta_(a/2), theta_(1-a/2)]. The displayed interval is reversed.

entries.question: Q3

reported.wording: all methods converge to similar true JRC values

entries.audit: Without external physical roughness truth, the N=400/dense result is a numerical reference/convergence target, not demonstrated ground truth accuracy.

entries.question: Q3
entries.audit: The correction coefficients need data source, estimator, uncertainty interpretation and validation split before cross-case transfer.

entries.question: Q3/Q4
entries.audit: Using JRCmax=20 as a similarity scale is not reconciled with reported JRC values up to 60. A scale parameter need not equal a hard maximum, but its semantic/empirical calibration must be stated; otherwise cross-stage weighting is arbitrary.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: 64% arithmetic is correct. The 85% statement cannot be the same isolation-rate statistic and needs a separate denominator/definition or correction.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: Not automatically contradictory: a connected component can contain many non-edge node pairs below threshold. But the table must define whether the mean is over retained edges, all within-cluster pairs, or another denominator.

entries.question: Q4

reported.Pc: product of five heuristic factors in [0,1]

entries.audit: Conditional-independence language does not by itself calibrate component scores as probabilities. Register this as a geometry/engineering compatibility score unless labeled connectivity or a generative likelihood validates probability semantics.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: This defines a deterministic spatial coverage/information surrogate. No random variable, posterior distribution or observation-noise model is specified, so posterior-uncertainty claims are unsupported.

entries.question: Q4

reported.information_gain: drop in the above uncertainty/coverage field after adding a candidate

entries.audit: This is marginal coverage-score improvement. Expected information gain would require averaging posterior uncertainty reduction over possible future observations.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: All new-new distances satisfy 500 mm. However the first new point is ~424.3 mm from existing hole 4. If the safety rule applies to all boreholes, the mathematical model is missing existing-new constraints; if it applies only among new holes, the text should say so.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: 24.474% rounds to 24.5%; arithmetic passes. The underlying fields remain non-reproducible without Attachment 9/data artifacts.

entries.question: ALL
entries.source: Appendix A Table 13 + available 2025 excellent-paper ZIP
entries.audit: The available collection contains the excellent-paper PDFs only. Attachment 9 code is not present, so S034 remains R1; do not infer implementation fidelity from pseudocode or generated figures.

global_gates: confusion metrics require ground-truth-mask provenance in addition to arithmetic replay
pseudocode output parameters must be generated by visible estimator primitives
dense numerical convergence is not physical ground truth
bootstrap estimator and CI ordering must match the claimed statistical procedure
cross-stage normalization/scale constants must be compatible with upstream value support
heuristic [0,1] factor products are scores until calibrated
deterministic coverage fields are not posterior uncertainty
marginal coverage reduction is not expected information gain
hard distance constraints must state and check every interacting set (new-new and existing-new)
